dataset.name: pharos-codeqa
dataset.labeling: Queries and graded relevance were written by hand by the benchmark author, from reading the source at the pinned commits, before any retrieval was run on these repositories. 'behavior' queries paraphrase what the code does without naming identifiers; 'identifier' queries name the API the way a developer would. Grade 2 = the implementation the question asks about; grade 1 = closely related and acceptable. Relevance is judged per indexed symbol (qualified name). Small n and a single annotator: treat differences inside the bootstrap confidence intervals as noise.
